segments.text:
V. 22.
Yet lackeſt thou one thing—Namely, To love GOD more than Mammon. Our Saviour knew his Heart, and preſently put him upon a Trial which laid it open to the Ruler himſelf. And to cure his Love of the World, which could not in him be cured otherwiſe, Chriſt commanded him. To ſell all that he had. But He does not command us to do this; but to uſe all to the Glory of GOD.
